This track was scrapped due to the release of Slick Rick's "The Great Adventures of Slick Rick" in 1988, which made De La Soul second-guess their own album with Posdnuos saying:
"This album was incredible. I looked at what we were doing and was like, ‘We need something else!’ I think that’s why I didn’t finish ‘Funny Weed.’ It was too fast; it was too light-hearted and too in the vein of ‘Three’s the Magic Number"

Orignal version of Scenario with basically everyone. Wasn't really a De La Soul or ATCQ song yet. DJ Johnny Juice stated that Posdnuos had the best verse, didn't even like the beat, had them turn off all samples and just rhymed on the drums. He also said the weakest verses were from Mr. Lawnge who rapped something he would later put on one of his own albums and Chris Light (rest in peace) who wasn't a rapper at all. Dres (Black Sheep) - ‘Never chose to listen, never chose to look/Never saw the movie, never read the book/Never something something/Never read the paper/Like Encyclopedia Brown I chose to close the caper!’ Maseo - ‘I got gift of gab and gift of hustle/Yeah I’m fat but I still got muscle/Some motherfuckers still wanna tussle/I smack that ass without no trouble.’
